identity_evidence.quote: A 36-year-old Gravida 6 Para 3 at 6 weeks 4 days of gestational age presented to the emergency room of our institution in July of 2020.

attribution_limitations: The text gives the two methotrexate doses on hospital day (HD) 2 and 6, whereas the Figure 1 caption says MTX was administered on days 1 and 4. The numbering frames (hospital day versus MTX day) and the dose interval (4 versus 3 days) are not reconciled by the source.

Three serum B-hCG values appear at different time points (2,359 at a different hospital, 3,838 at the index presentation, 4,166.7 described as pre-treatment); the source does not say whether 4,166.7 is the same measurement as either other value.
